title: Site Update: Unified Edition
description: Merged six community launchers into one offline-first launcher with 113 builds.
notes: Merged the Web, Mobile/Controller, Modded, Alpha and Beta editions into one launcher.
Added the live Servers screen, Skins library and offline Downloads packager.
Added eight themes, text scaling, six launch modes and custom installations.
Restored 113 catalogue builds with per-build icons and verified recovery.
Made the launcher fully offline: self-hosted fonts, local fallbacks and isolation headers.

title: Site Update: Alpha and Beta
description: Split the Alpha and Beta builds into their own rail sections with spawner and TNT icons.
notes: Added the Alpha Releases section with six builds.
Added the Beta Releases section with fourteen builds.
WASM builds now use the matching -wasm block icon.

title: Site Update: Modded Editions
description: Expanded the Modded catalogue to 35 third-party clients including Resent 4.0 and 3.8.
notes: Added Resent 4.0 and Resent 3.8, Astra, PixelClient and Tuff WASM builds.
Every modded client now shows its real icon.
Removed the GX client.

title: Site Update: Servers and Downloads
description: Added the live server browser and per-client offline downloads.
notes: Servers now poll each relay for MOTD, player count and ping.
Downloads can package any client as a standalone .html or .zip.
Custom servers can be added, copied and joined.

title: Site Update: Skins and Settings
description: Added the skins library with canvas previews and inline quick settings.
notes: Skins can be equipped into the Eaglercraft profile.
Quick Stats shows playtime, sessions and an FPS-Boost toggle.
Volume, performance mode and auto-save sit inline in Settings.

title: Site Update: Offline First
description: Made the launcher offline-first with self-hosted fonts and a bundled server.
notes: Roboto is now self-hosted, so the launcher renders with no network.
The bundled server sends cross-origin isolation headers for WASM builds.
Added the verification suite covering transport, catalogues, skins and geometry.

title: Site Update: Customizable
description: Added customizable launcher options, credits, settings, more memory options, and updated code!
notes: Added customizable launcher options, allowing users to create their own name and icon.
Added credits screen, displaying everybody who has contributed.
Added the settings screen, allowing users to customize the launcher, and learn info.
Implemented more memory on choices made inside of the launcher.
Updated games, fixed bugs, modified css.

title: Site Update: Modded
description: Added patch notes, bug fixes, and integrated mods!
notes: Added the mod screen, which allows users to select mods, and it'll be added to their eaglerforge launcher. Will override mods added in by user inside of launcher.
Added the patch notes screen, it displays recent updates to the website, and launcher builds.
Fixed a bug of unable to scroll with to many launchers selected.
Fixed sizing bugs of website.

title: Site Update: Memorized
description: Organized/updated code, added memory options, more games, installations, usernames, and faq screen!
notes: Implemented memory for options selected inside of launcher.
Added wider range of game versions.
Added usernames into launcher.
Added FAQ screen, answering common easy questions.
Removed bulk code for sleeker function/look.
Organize structure of project for future growth.
